name: Daily API monitor -> change detection -> Slack/Discord alert

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { text: 'Rate alert ' + $json.date + ' (base ' + $json.base + ')\n' + $json.moves.map(m => m.symbol + ': ' + (m.change_pct > 0 ? '+' : '') + m.change_pct + '% (' + m.old + ' -> ' + m.new + ')').join('\n'), content: 'Rate alert ' + $json.date } }}
